title: Rees On Wiregrass | KEY.co
description_expanded: This property not only offers visual appeal but also caters to comfort and convenience, featuring a private pool, a separate carriage house, and a golf cart for easy exploration. The gourmet kitchen is equipped with top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, a beverage and wine bar, and ample seating, making it a chef’s delight and a focal point for social gatherings. The outdoor space is equally impressive, complete with a luxury kitchen and gas grill, ideal for alfresco dining and family get-togethers. Additionally, the home is fitted with Sonos Wireless Surround Sound throughout, ensuring that your favorite tunes accompany every moment. Whether indulging in a movie night in the media room or retreating to the luxurious guest bedrooms, each with its private bathrooms, this home promises a beach vacation that you and your family will cherish forever. Immerse yourself in luxury at this stunning coastal dream home located in the Lake District of WaterColor. Constructed by Borges Brooks Builders and exquisitely designed by Katie Grace Designs, this residence showcases unparalleled attention to detail across its expansive five-bedroom, eight-bathroom layout. Perfect for large family gatherings, the home invites relaxation and entertainment with its open-concept design, featuring a light and airy décor that captures the essence of beachside living. The living areas boast a gas fireplace for cozy evenings and large accordion-style doors that open to reveal breathtaking views of the pool and outdoor lounge areas, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor experience.
